description: Content that rises from the bottom (DESIGN.md, Sheet): a box with its top corners TsuyaRadius.lg, a handle to drag down on touch, and child padded TsuyaSpace.s24; on glass when glass, the surface otherwise. Show it with Sheet.show, which also gives it its scrim, Escape and press-outside dismissal, and its focus trap. label names it for a screen reader.

constructors.description: A sheet named label showing child.

params.name: label
params.description: The accessible name: what the sheet is about.

params.name: glass
params.description: Glass instead of the surface, for a sheet that opens from glass.

statics.name: show
statics.signature: Future<T?> show<T>(BuildContext context, {required WidgetBuilder builder, String? barrierLabel, SheetSide side = SheetSide.bottom})
statics.description: Shows builder's sheet above everything, over a scrim, sliding in over TsuyaDuration.sheet; completes with what close gives, or null once dismissed (Escape, a press on the scrim, a drag down on touch). side chooses the bottom sheet or the desktop panel. barrierLabel names the scrim for a screen reader.

statics.name: close
statics.description: Closes the sheet context belongs to, completing Sheet.show's future with result.
